text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoo! Finally, finally, finally, finally! 
It's finally starting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is correct!
The curtains covering our commemoration of
the 
WINNING DREAM STAGE are finally…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The endless wasteland… filled with untouched
gold 
veins and mysterious ancient ruins! Mac-chan,
take 
my hand! Let's embark on a new adventure!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What are you trying to do!?
We are performing a L-I-V-E concert! 
Do you understand? A live concert!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
Golshi is saying crazy things again.
But I guess it's 
McQueen's fault for always believing what
she says… Wait, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hello, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!? My name is Special Week 
and I will be singing!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…Spe-chan, it's not your turn yet,
you know? 
You seem… really nervous.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Auu… Y-Yes, just a little… 
Wait no, I'm really nervous!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been working really hard to make
sure that everything 
goes well today… I just don't want to ruin
it…!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yuh stupid idjit!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nuwa! Spe,
you're always lookin back!!
You need to start facin' 
your toes forward, doncha think!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!? M-My toes…? 
But they're always facing forward!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Err, well… While I may not fully understand
what 
Goldship-san is saying,
it still makes se-… or 
rather, it still makes about 20% sense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate something is to not only
remember what happened in 
the past,
but also to carve out a new future with
it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, in short,
it's not about what we've done so far,
it's about 
what we're going to do from now on.
That's what she meant♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Spe-chan. 
Just remember…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Since the beginning,
we've been running forward with all our 
heart… day after day, rain or shine,
right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Don't look back… Just keep moving forward.
Forward…!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We will convey our hopes 
and dreams with our song…!
